selection: Five purposefully selected awarded IEEE/ACM conference works. This is an editorial comparison, not a systematic prevalence study or a publication rule.

papers.title: Photon
papers.editorial_observation: Organizes execution, representation and integration around consequential design alternatives. Keeps the task and memory models visible because they explain measured behavior.

papers.title: Incremental Stream Query Placement
papers.editorial_observation: Introduces the model and component workflow, then explains state transitions and concurrent resource consistency. Examples illuminate the algorithm rather than repository organization.

papers.title: Reverse Regret Query
papers.editorial_observation: Defines the problem before algorithms and separates exact and approximate obligations. Correctness arguments, pruning conditions and costs justify implementation choices.

papers.title: SAGA
papers.editorial_observation: Connects the objective and API contract to logical/physical representations and optimization. Distinguishes the general method from the inventory of individual cleaning primitives.

papers.title: Detecting Logic Bugs of Join Optimizations in DBMS
papers.reviewed_sections: Sections 2-4; later author preprint of the awarded work
papers.editorial_observation: Prioritizes the testing oracle, generation and search mechanisms. Concrete defects support the method and its evaluation, without substituting a development diary for either.
